question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the shipped `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close the linked PR and this issue as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can verify the released helper is affected and the open PR fixes it, but current main has removed that helper and now documents a different supported skill-creation path, which is a maintainer product-boundary decision.

options.title: Close obsolete cluster
options.body: Close the open PR and this issue together with evidence that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

options.title: Refresh or backport helper repair
options.body: Ask for a current-main-compatible or release-branch repair that intentionally keeps the helper contract, adds mixed-case parser coverage, and explains the support window.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete cluster
recommendation.body: Close the open PR and this issue together with evidence that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The same owner history covers both the original bundled helper and the current Skill Workshop replacement direction.
